protocol.description: This protocol allows a privileged client to set the gamma tables for outputs.

description.summary: manager to create per-output gamma controls
get a gamma control for an output
adjust gamma tables for an output

arg.name: size
arg.summary: number of elements in a ramp

request.name: set_gamma
request.description: Set the gamma table: the file descriptor contains three consecutive arrays of gamma_size 16-bit unsigned integers (red, green, blue).
